paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Metzia 22a, where R' Yohanan [speaks] in his name; but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak, as in the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: ב״מ/כב. give Bava Metzia 22a contextually and by period convention; no fresh passage check. Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim are conventional labels for הרא״ש/דק״ס, without adding author identities or verifying editions. Hyman claims their support for his definite Yishmael-to-Shimon correction. Yochanan transmits in the headed person’s name, not merely mentions him; speaks is bracketed because the verb is implicit. All three personal-title abbreviations remain R'.
